build_vit_small: build a VisionTransformer small model with patch size 16 and 384 embedding dimensions
build_vit_base: build a VisionTransformer base model with patch size 16 and 768 embedding dimensions
build_vit_large: build a VisionTransformer large model with patch size 16 and 1024 embedding dimensions
load_mae_encoder: load a MAE encoder checkpoint into a VisionTransformer model with positional embedding resizing
load_contrastive_vit: load a contrastive learning checkpoint into a VisionTransformer model filtering base_encoder keys
